On Wed, Nov 17, 2021 at 10:37 PM Danny Rogers < [opaque block]
Hey! Sorry, took me an extra day to get back to you. Yes, absolutely, would love to, and I spoke about this with my Co-
Founder and l'Il just plan on doing this in a personal capacity, if that is ok with you (though mentioning my affiliation and
our work is totally fine).
Let's discuss - how's 1pm ET on Monday to chat? Can also do noon on Wednesday if it's not too close to the holiday
for you.
Cc'ing *my* work email address, too, in case you need it.
Thanks, and very much looking forward to it!
Danny

Hi Danny,
As a follow up to our phone call.... this is my work email address.
1 am currently in USAID's Office of Security. Our office hosts a Guest Speaker Series to help USAID better
understand security-related issues impacting our work. Our last speaker was Peter Lord, VP of Strategic Initiatives [contact omitted]
Oracle. Before that were the authors of this paper from RAND.
Please let me know if you'd like to build out a 1 hour webinar that will be open to all of USAID. We'd shoot for
sometime in mid-December. I'm thinking something along the lines of disinformation, dark web, authoritarianism.
Get back to me when you can.
Thanks,
Daniel
